faq.q: Can I sell a Houston house with a leaking roof?
faq.a: Yes, but the buyer needs an accurate picture of the known condition and the contract must reflect the parties' agreement. Gather reports, estimates, photos and any insurance documents before comparing a repair, listing or as-is sale.

faq.q: Will homeowners insurance replace an old roof before I sell?
faq.a: Not simply because the roof is old or worn. The Texas Department of Insurance says coverage depends on the policy and cause of loss; storm or tree damage is different from ordinary wear.

faq.q: Should I accept a roofing estimate before comparing sale options?
faq.a: A written estimate can clarify scope, but it is not the same as a completed repair or a guaranteed insurance payment. Compare the estimate, timing, deductible and sale terms together.

faq.q: Does selling as-is remove my disclosure responsibilities?
faq.a: Do not assume it does. Texas disclosure requirements and exemptions depend on the transaction. Describe known facts honestly and obtain legal or licensed professional advice for your specific situation.
